subject.title: fix(skills): coding-agent completion works with SecretRef auth

question: Should the bundled coding-agent skill standardize parent-owned terminal delivery, with the parent kept active until its one notification attempt completes, rather than ever delegating Gateway-authenticated delivery to restricted workers?
rationale: This resolves the reported SecretRef failure without credential injection, but it changes the durable ownership and lifecycle contract of an optional external-worker workflow.

options.title: Adopt parent-owned delivery
options.body: Confirm the parent as the sole delivery owner after a redacted success-and-failure proof shows it preserves strict SecretRef isolation.

options.title: Design a scoped worker capability
options.body: Keep worker-originated completion only if maintainers want a narrowly scoped, non-exportable notification capability with an explicit security contract.

recommendation.title: Adopt parent-owned delivery
recommendation.body: Confirm the parent as the sole delivery owner after a redacted success-and-failure proof shows it preserves strict SecretRef isolation.

likelyOwner.reason: Their merged work is the closest available history signal for preserving fail-closed SecretRef behavior across Gateway-facing paths.
